_comment: The device inventory for the Pi 2B station described in HARDWARE.md, as
shipped by deploy/install.sh when the box has no inventory of its own.
It is INTENT, not detection. The station keeps the two apart on purpose
(contract/enrolment.md §7): this file says what someone believes is
fitted, and the station reports separately what it actually found. A
camera that has failed and a camera that was never fitted look identical
in a database and completely different at the site.
All four devices below have a driver in this build. Where a slot cannot
yet produce readings it says why on its own telemetry stream, published
as available:false on the normal cadence rather than faked or gone quiet.
The serial ports are EMPTY and have to be set on the setup page, because
only the box knows its own /dev/serial/by-id/ names. Anything else would
be a guess that works until the first reboot swaps the two adapters over.
The radio's tuner allocation is EMPTY for the same reason: a dongle is
claimed by serial number, one band at a time, and only the box knows the
serial of the one plugged into it. Assign it on the setup page.

adsb._comment: uAvionix ping RX Pro, MAVLink over USB-UART at 57600. Driver written and unit-tested; the serial layer beneath it has never spoken to a real UART. NOT YET CONNECTED as of HARDWARE.md — until it is, this slot reports the port as missing and adsb goes out as available:false.

weather._comment: Airmar 110WX, NMEA 0183 at 4800. Set humidity_module true ONLY if the RH variant was ordered — without it there is no humidity source and the field is published absent, never zero. mast_offset_deg is the mast's true bearing: the instrument has no compass, and a wrong value here rotates every wind reading at the site.

radio._comment: RTL2838 on airband, driven by gsu/radio/rtlsdr.py. Demodulates on the station: audio goes up only while the squelch is open and IQ never leaves the site, which is the point on a metered link. Needs numpy and librtlsdr0 installed (see requirements.txt) and needs its tuner ASSIGNED on the setup page - resource is null here because only the box knows its dongle's serial. Gain is fixed at 37.2 dB and not auto: the tuner AGC desenses near strong transmitters, and every squelch threshold in this receiver is an absolute level. ppm 0 is a starting guess - this tuner can come up mis-programmed by hundreds of ppm with no error reported, so a channel that is silent after a restart wants a power-cycle before it wants a number here.

camera._comment: Pi camera on the CSI ribbon. Driven now: snapshots go to gsu/{station_id}/video and the live H.264 stream is started on demand by the platform. 640x480 rather than the sensor's full size because this setting is a BANDWIDTH decision, not a picture-quality one - a real 640x480 frame is 30-60 kB, so 2 fps is already 640-1280 kbit/s on a metered link, and 1080p snapshots would be five times that (HARDWARE.md §8). The live stream is where full resolution belongs, because it only runs while somebody is watching. Never yet run against a real camera.

power._comment: Nothing specified for this site yet. Not fitted is a different statement from fitted-and-broken, so the slot is left empty rather than pointed at a Victron that is not there.

light._comment: No relay fitted. Same reasoning as power.
